name: github
label: GitHub
purpose: The connection to GitHub: which repository this project is, which account it works as, who the people are. The ticket process itself is the Tickets plugin's and runs without this; with this on, certain parts of it reach GitHub - a filed ticket becomes an issue, its state follows as status: labels, a note on it becomes a comment - and what is already on GitHub comes back: the issues Cockpit has no ticket for join the board and Pipeline, the pull requests that name a ticket show on it, what is stuck there joins Needs attention. Read with the gh command line every few minutes.

questions.label: Repository
questions.help: as gh names it; gh must already be logged in on the engine's machine

questions.label: GitHub account for this project
questions.help: the login this project WORKS AS: shown as "you" on the cards, and - if gh on the engine's machine is logged into it - the account the feed reads with and every AI turn pushes as. gh keeps several logins; add one with: gh auth login

questions.label: People
questions.help: login=name, comma-separated. Everyone else appears by login.

questions.label: Look back (days)
questions.help: closed tickets and merged PRs older than this are not fetched; open work always is

questions.label: Local-model PR title prefix (optional)
questions.help: PRs whose title starts with this were opened by a local model and wait for a frontier to finish them
